summary: A capital markets and retail focus day: Reliance to raise $1.3 billion via rupee bond sale, its first since 2023, while Vadilal Enterprises blocks renewal of decade-long distribution pact with Vadilal Industries, signaling potential market disruption in organized ice cream retail.

bullets.text: Reliance Industries to raise $1.3 billion via 5-year rupee bond sale next week, first issuance since 2023.
Vadilal Enterprises blocks renewal of 10-year distribution agreement with ice cream maker Vadilal Industries ahead of expiration.
upGrad acquired 100% of Unacademy's share capital from existing shareholders for USD 206 million via share swap with Steadview Capital backing.
Consumer startups raised over Rs 300 crore in funding this week; FMCG brands like Sorry Sugar, Marmalade, and Lickicious combined for Rs 30+ crore.
Chief Justice Sunita Agarwal outlined five principles for AI in arbitration, emphasizing balance between artificial intelligence and human judgment in dispute resolution.
